issues.description: image.tobytes() called without .convert('RGB') will emit mis-sized bytes for non-RGB modes
issues.detail: Gemini may return PNG/JPEG in RGBA, palette, or grayscale modes. Calling Image.open(...).tobytes() and declaring format='RGB' on OutputImageRawFrame produces byte buffers whose length and layout do not match the declared format/size. Downstream renderers will produce garbled images. Fix: img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(...)).convert('RGB') before tobytes().

issues.description: Module-import-time monkey-patch of private genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE is fragile and process-global
issues.detail: Mutating a private SDK attribute at import time affects every google-genai consumer in the process and will silently break on any SDK reorganization. The 'temporary hack' comment is honest but the fix is not durable. Use a documented config path, isolate the override behind explicit opt-in, or upstream a fix with a version-pin guard.

issues.description: Silent default model change from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash bundled into feature PR
issues.detail: Flipping the default model is a user-visible behavior change affecting cost, latency, and output for every caller relying on the default. The CHANGELOG entry is a one-liner with no migration note. This is a separate decision from adding image support and should be split into its own PR or documented loudly with a deprecation path.

issues.description: No tests covering the new inline_data image branch or thinking-budget gating
issues.detail: The new elif branch in _process_context and the _maybe_unset_thinking_budget skip have no unit tests. An example script requiring a live API key is not a regression suite. Add tests exercising inline_data handling, mode normalization, and the image-model branch before merge.

issues.description: Substring 'image' in model name is brittle stringly-typed model classification
issues.detail: Disabling thinking_budget when 'image' in self._model_name will misfire on any future model whose name contains the substring for unrelated reasons. Replace with an explicit capability table or known-model set keyed by model id, so the rule ('image-generation models do not accept thinking_config') is data, not string-sniffing.

issues.description: Dependency specifiers widened from ~= pins to >=x,<major ranges without rationale
issues.detail: Moving google-genai and the two cloud SDKs from ~= pins to broad >= ranges trades reproducibility for upgrade latitude. The PR does not state the tradeoff or acknowledge that future minor releases will land in user resolves without review. Add an explicit note justifying the loosening.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the PR NEEDS WORK before merge. Two P0 issues dominate: PIL image.tobytes() is called without .convert('RGB'), almost certainly producing garbled frames for non-RGB Gemini outputs, and a module-import-time monkey-patch on google-genai's private _api_client mutates process-global SDK state. Secondary concerns include a silent default-model flip bundled into the feature PR, absence of tests for the new image branch, brittle substring-based model classification, and dependency specifier loosening without rationale. Recommendation: fix the RGB conversion, replace the SDK hack with a supported config path, split the default-model change into its own PR, and add unit tests before landing.
